name: Elizabeth Parker-Fawley
tagline: Top rated Employment & Labor attorney in Glendale, California
education: University of California Los Angeles (UCLA) School of Law
about: Elizabeth Parker-Fawley is a dedicated attorney at Lawyers for Justice, P.C. ® , in Glendale, California, where she focuses her practice on employment law. She represents workers in complex class and representative actions, advocating for fair treatment in the workplace. Her work spans various industries, including finance, logistics and manufacturing.

Ms. Parker-Fawley achieved a major legal victory by certifying thousands of bank employees in a case involving unpaid wages and denied meal and rest periods. Her strategic litigation style and commitment to accountability have made her a strong advocate for employee rights throughout California.

With a law degree from the University of California, Los Angeles, School of Law, Ms. Parker-Fawley stood out as a semi-finalist in the Roscoe Pound Moot Court Competition. She also served as vice president of External Competitions on the Moot Court Board, sharpening her skills in oral advocacy and legal strategy. Her undergraduate studies in history and broadcast journalism at Chapman University gave her a solid foundation in research, analysis and effective communication skills that now serve her clients in and out of the courtroom.

Ms. Parker-Fawley’s passion for employment law was sparked during her time volunteering at the Bet Tzedek legal clinic, where she helped underserved individuals facing workplace injustices. That early experience continues to inspire her commitment to leveling the playing field for workers.

Driven by integrity and purpose, Ms. Parker-Fawley brings tenacity and empathy to every case she handles. She believes that no worker should feel powerless and works tirelessly to hold employers accountable and deliver meaningful results for her clients. Ms. Parker-Fawley is licensed to practice law in the state of California.
